name: Walkthrough recording
responsibility: A page recording one walkthrough's talk: it moves the pane a step at a time as the voice paces it, and keeps the voice and each step and subtitle line on one clock
description: Asked for by the page's address. The page shows the one pane (RecordingStage) instead of the shell and publishes its side of the recording contract through the walkthrough package, for the recorder that drives it (drawn on Board rasterizer). The page is its own tab session, so voice that is live in another tab does not refuse it. The voice's audio element is muted, so nobody hears it, and its stream is tapped through Web Audio. The talk's lines are the voice's own lines of the transcript on the pane's transport, and its drawn versions are what the pane reports. The page captures no picture: the replay draws every frame again from the talk. The recording page accepts the exact canonical playback payload through the existing load contract before voice starts. It drives canonical beats and reports the captured revision on the existing clock.

outgoing.label: voice as a recording in its language; each step shown
outgoing.description: The page asks the server's agent for voice narrating this walkthrough as a recording in the language it was opened with, and reports each step it shows, which the server tells the voice model as it does a step chosen by hand. Only a recording carries a language: the voice is told to speak only that language, whatever language a step is written in.
